faq.q: What is the sea temperature in Marbella in May 2030?
faq.a: In May 2030, the Mediterranean sea temperature off Marbella averages 19°C. It warms through the month, reaching 21°C by late May. Swimming, snorkelling, and jet skiing are comfortable, especially during midday hours.

faq.q: Is May a good time for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, May is excellent for a Marbella boat rental. You get warm 22-25°C air temperatures, 12 hours of daylight, and calm seas. It's pre-season, so marinas like Puerto Banús are less crowded, and charter availability is high.

faq.q: What is the wind like in Marbella in May?
faq.a: May typically has light winds of 5-15 knots from the west or southwest. The Levante (easterly) is rare this month, so sea conditions are calm with wave heights below 0.5m. Ideal for both motor yachts and catamarans.

faq.q: Can I swim in the sea during a May charter?
faq.a: Absolutely. Sea temperatures of 19-21°C are refreshing but not cold. Most guests swim at anchorages like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. We provide towels and snorkelling gear on request.

faq.q: What should I wear for a May boat trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Light layers work best: a T-shirt, shorts, and a light jacket or jumper for the evening breeze. Bring sunscreen (SPF 50), a hat, and sunglasses. Non-slip boat shoes are recommended.

faq.q: Do you offer sunset cruises in May?
faq.a: Yes, sunset cruises are very popular in May. Sunset is around 21:15-21:30, so we offer 2-hour evening charters from 19:30. Our Azimut 58 Flybridge and Mangusta 80 are perfect for watching the sun dip behind La Concha.

faq.q: What is the weather like in Puerto Banús in May?
faq.a: Puerto Banús enjoys a microclimate with May averages of 23°C air temperature and 70% sunshine. Rain is rare (only 20mm for the whole month). The marina is lively but not as packed as July or August.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a May charter?
faq.a: We recommend booking 2-3 weeks ahead for May, as demand is growing. Last-minute bookings (3-5 days) are often possible, but popular boats like the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 go fast. Use WhatsApp for real-time availability.

data.body_html:
Marbella boat rental weather in May 2030 delivers near-perfect conditions for pre-season charters: sea temperatures of 19°C, 12 hours of sunshine, and gentle breezes. Whether you want to cruise the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro, or jet ski off Puerto Banús, May offers warm days without the summer crowds. All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA — so you just show up and enjoy.

May 2030 Weather Overview for Marbella

May is the start of the Mediterranean summer. Average air temperatures range from 22°C in early May to 25°C by the end of the month. Sea temperatures climb from 18°C to 21°C, making swimming comfortable by midday. Winds are typically light (5-15 knots) from the west, with calm seas and wave heights under 0.5m. Rainfall is minimal — just 20mm across the month — and you can expect 12 hours of daylight. Sunset is around 21:15, perfect for evening charters.

Best Boats for May Conditions

May's calm seas suit any vessel in our fleet. For a budget-friendly option, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749 for 2 hours (Tier A pricing). If you want space and speed, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski from €4,719 for 4 hours. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) offer luxury lounging and dining areas. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Where to Go in May: Top Anchorages

With calm seas, you can reach multiple spots in a half-day charter. Popular destinations include:

  • Cala del Faro — 15 minutes from Puerto Banús, a sheltered cove with clear water.
  • Cala Cortés — 20 minutes east, quiet and scenic.
  • Estepona coast — 30 minutes west, with beach clubs like Selwo Marina.
  • Sotogrande — 45 minutes south, exclusive marina and golf views.

Your skipper will recommend the best route based on wind and swell.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't pay extra for fuel or tips — the price is all-in. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the rate is €749 for 2 hours, €1,099 for 4 hours, €1,499 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80 variants) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Why May is the Smart Season

May is pre-peak season, meaning lower prices, better availability, and uncrowded anchorages. You can book a 6-hour charter for the price of a 4-hour in August. The weather is stable — 90% of days are sunny with no rain. Plus, the sea is calm enough for water sports like jet skiing, paddleboarding, and snorkelling. If you want a relaxed, high-value experience, May is the sweet spot.

How to Book Your May 2030 Charter

Reserve your boat via WhatsApp for real-time availability. We recommend booking 2-3 weeks ahead for popular boats like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge. Payment is secure via bank transfer or card. On the day, meet your skipper at Puerto Banús at the agreed time. All boats are cleaned and fuelled before departure. For more details, read our Marbella boat rental guide.

In May 2030, the Mediterranean sea temperature off Marbella averages 19°C. It warms through the month, reaching 21°C by late May. Swimming, snorkelling, and jet skiing are comfortable, especially during midday hours.

May typically has light winds of 5-15 knots from the west or southwest. The Levante (easterly) is rare this month, so sea conditions are calm with wave heights below 0.5m. Ideal for both motor yachts and catamarans.
